news.analysis: Lock wasn't able to log a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday. He was limited due to an elbow injury that he's dealing with, which is less than ideal given that he is set to start in place of Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) this week.
news.contents: Drew Lock (elbow) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.title: Drew Lock (elbow) limited at practice Wednesday

news.contents: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Drew Lock (elbow) logged a limited practice session on Wednesday, according to the team's official injury report.
